name: AE project edit approval receipt schema
purpose: Machine-readable receipt shape for explicit human approval before AE execution or project writes in the external AE project edit workflow.

receipt.approved_by: operator identifier string; required for approved receipts
receipt.approved_at_utc: UTC timestamp string; required for approved receipts

approval_scope.ir_id: IR id from the adapter report or request-pair manifest
approval_scope.request_pair_manifest_digest: metadata-only sha256-v1 digest copied from request-pair manifest binding.cryptographic_digest.digest_hex; must match the reviewed manifest
approval_scope.request_pair_manifest_binding_algorithm: fnv1a64-v1-noncryptographic in the current adapter output
approval_scope.request_pair_manifest_binding_checksum: metadata-only checksum from the request-pair manifest binding block; must match the reviewed manifest
approval_scope.source_project_path: caller-reviewed source path; must not be overwritten

prerequisite_reports.review_packet_binding_checksum: copied from review packet report review_packet_binding.checksum_hex
prerequisite_reports.generated_jsx_artifact_verification_repo: true when the review packet includes a checked generated JSX transaction artifact verification report; otherwise false in the draft template. This acknowledgement does not make artifact verification an approval receipt.
prerequisite_reports.export_artifact_manifest_reviewed: true when the review packet includes a checked standalone export artifact manifest; otherwise false in the draft template. This acknowledgement does not make the export manifest an approval scope.
prerequisite_reports.export_artifact_verification_report_revi: true when the review packet includes a checked standalone export artifact verification report; otherwise false in the draft template. This acknowledgement does not make artifact verification an approval receipt.
prerequisite_reports.aepx_dry_run_reviewed: true when the review packet includes a checked AEPX dry-run report; otherwise false is allowed. This acknowledgement does not authorize AEPX apply or writes.
prerequisite_reports.aepx_preservation_proof_reviewed: true when the review packet includes a checked synthetic AEPX preservation proof report; otherwise false in the draft template. This acknowledgement does not authorize production AEPX apply or writes.
prerequisite_reports.aepx_production_lane_preflight_reviewed: true when the review packet includes a checked AEPX production-lane preflight report; otherwise false in the draft template. This acknowledgement does not authorize AEPX apply, real .aepx input, or binary .aep editing.

non_goals: This receipt schema does not launch After Effects.
This receipt schema does not execute JSX.
This receipt schema does not prove project save success.
This receipt schema does not authorize source overwrite or direct binary .aep writing.
This receipt schema does not cover AEX, OFX, or AviUtl core work.

approved_requires: receipt id, approved_by, and approved_at_utc are non-empty
approval scope paths match the request-pair manifest
binding checksum matches the request-pair manifest
request-pair manifest digest matches the request-pair manifest
review packet report artifact is present and status is review_ready
review packet paths and binding checksum match the request-pair manifest
review packet includes metadata-only downstream validate and generated JSX report bindings/digests
review packet includes generated JSX artifact digest metadata and does not embed the generated JSX body
if the review packet includes generated JSX transaction artifact verification evidence, the receipt acknowledges it and the validator proves it remains accepted_as_approval=false

if the review packet includes standalone export artifact manifest or verification evidence, the receipt acknowledges those reviewed artifacts and the validator proves they remain accepted_as_approval=false
if the review packet includes AEPX dry-run evidence, the receipt acknowledges that evidence and the validator proves it remains accepted_as_apply=false

if the review packet includes synthetic AEPX preservation proof evidence, the receipt acknowledges that evidence and the validator proves it remains synthetic-only, exact-byte-diff verified, and accepted_as_apply=false
if the review packet includes AEPX production-lane preflight evidence, the receipt acknowledges that evidence and the validator proves it remains gate-closed and accepted_as_apply=false
approval receipt prerequisite_reports.review_packet_binding_checksum matches the review packet report binding checksum
approval receipt prerequisite_reports.review_packet_digest_hex matches the review packet report cryptographic digest
request-pair manifest and generated JSX have been reviewed
source overwrite and direct binary .aep write remain forbidden
approved_is_not: permission for tools to launch AE
permission to run AEX, OFX, or AviUtl core logic

notes: A request-pair manifest remains required_pending until an external receipt matching this schema is produced and reviewed.

The current adapter emits both a metadata-only non-cryptographic binding checksum and a metadata-only sha256-v1 digest so approval can bind to the reviewed manifest without embedding private patch payloads.

The tool may emit draft_unapproved templates to reduce transcription mistakes, but those templates are not approval and validators must reject them until a human fills required fields and sets approval_status=approved.
Approval validation requires a matching ae_project_edit_review_packet validation report with validation_status=review_ready; receipt text alone is not enough.

When a review packet includes optional generated JSX transaction artifact verification evidence, ae_project_edit_approval must require the matching human reviewed acknowledgement and still keep that verifier out of approval scope.

When a review packet includes optional standalone export artifact manifest or artifact verification evidence, ae_project_edit_approval must require the matching human reviewed acknowledgements and still keep those artifacts out of the approval scope.

When a review packet includes optional AEPX dry-run evidence, ae_project_edit_approval must carry its metadata-only binding/digest into the validation report, require a human acknowledgement, and still require aepx_dry_run_accepted_as_apply=false.

When a review packet includes optional synthetic AEPX preservation proof evidence, ae_project_edit_approval must require a human acknowledgement and still require aepx_preservation_proof_accepted_as_apply=false plus production_apply_enabled=false.

When a review packet includes optional AEPX production-lane preflight evidence, ae_project_edit_approval must require a human acknowledgement and still require aepx_production_lane_preflight_accepted_as_apply=false plus production/binary/write gates closed.
Approval is scoped to explicit source/output/generated JSX paths and the request-pair manifest, not to arbitrary future edits.
The snapshot-to-JSX export artifact manifest is review metadata only; ae_project_edit_approval must reject ae_jsx_export_artifact_manifest as a request-pair approval scope.
An approved receipt may permit a manual AE smoke step, but only saving to the explicit output path.
Rejected or revoked receipts must not be treated as permission to execute AE or write projects.
